title: Platform Engineer (AWS)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer , DevOps Engineer , or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement .
  • Deep expertise in AWS , especially working with services like ECS , IAM , and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub , GitHub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage .
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic , such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced) .


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform , enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations

*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Executivo (a) Comercial Externo
description:
Executivo(a) Comercial | Transforme o Setor de Energia com a Gente!


⚡ Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil


Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.


A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.


Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui


Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo


Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.


Você será a peça-chave para:


  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.


Principais Responsabilidades:


️Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Somos uma escola de idiomas online que oferece aulas particulares ao vivo, sob demanda, com foco em conversação e situações reais do dia a dia. Nosso método é comunicativo e baseado em lexical chunks, expressões úteis e naturais do idioma, para ajudar nossos alunos a se comunicarem com confiança desde as primeiras aulas.


Nossa escola está iniciando uma nova fase e abrindo vagas para professores de inglês online que queiram fazer parte de algo diferente. As aulas começam oficialmente no dia 5 de janeiro de 2026 , e este será o início de um projeto que une tecnologia, flexibilidade e um método de ensino moderno focado na comunicação real. Se você acredita que ensinar inglês vai muito além da gramática, e quer participar de um projeto em crescimento, esta oportunidade é para você.


Carga horária de 8 horas de diárias, segunda a sexta com horários pela manhã ou pela noite.


Responsabilidades

Dar aulas particulares online (1:1) a alunos de diferentes níveis.

Seguir o plano de aula e o método comunicativo da escola.

Ajudar o aluno a praticar vocabulário e expressões do cotidiano.

Corrigir a pronúncia, gramática e fluência de forma natural durante a conversa.

Escrever um breve feedback após cada aula.

title: Remote SAT English Tutor - 50997
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

Day-to-day responsibilities:

As an SAT Tutor, you will work remotely with high school students preparing for U.S. college admissions. Your sessions will focus on strengthening reading, writing, and mathematical reasoning skills using official materials and proven strategies. You’ll conduct timed practice tests, review performance, and create personalized study plans to help students maximize their scores. Clear communication, consistent feedback, and student motivation will be essential to building confidence and exam readiness.


Requirements:

We’re seeking experienced tutors with a strong record of preparing students for the SAT. Candidates should understand the digital SAT format, be familiar with College Board materials, and have excellent academic English skills. High SAT scores or standardized test prep certifications are preferred. Strong teaching abilities, virtual instruction skills, and a results-driven approach are essential. Communication in English: Ability to clearly convey feedback, nuances, and progress updates to the team.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: Availability of up to 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 1 month
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los-Angeles

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Business Analyst Trainee — Marketing Automation & AI
description:
Type: 90‑day, full‑time remote internship/trainee program (paid)

Pay: USD $1,000 / month

Contract: Independent contractor (Canada‑based company)

Future: Outstanding interns may receive a full‑time offer.

Non-negotiable requirement: Advanced English


Ready to Apply? We value thoughtful applications over quick submissions. Please send short introduction video to j Include any relevant experience or examples of your work that demonstrate your skills in building things.


Alternatively, you will receive an automated email to prepare a one-way video interview as the first step of the hiring process.


What You’ll Do

  • Build from zero: Stand up internal marketing‑agency systems, analytics stacks, and repeatable processes—often with no existing playbook.
  • Automate & optimize: Map workflows, identify bottlenecks, and deploy no‑code/low‑code, AI, or integration tools (Cursor, Replit, Zapier, Make, GPT, etc.) to streamline them.
  • Turn data into insight: Design dashboards and translate numbers into actionable narratives for stakeholders.
  • Ship & educate: Draft launch content, craft go‑to‑market strategies, and create user‑friendly training to ensure adoption.


You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • Learn fast: You welcome constructive pushback and treat every project as a chance to sharpen your craft.
  • Love variety: Each day’s challenges differ—expect context switching and rapid iteration.
  • Communicate crisply: Advanced written and spoken English is non‑negotiable.
  • Stay curious: New tech doesn’t scare you; you experiment until it bends to the problem.


Core Skills…

  • Professional/Bilingual proficiency in English. All business activities require an advanced level of English
  • Business writing & stakeholder persuasion
  • Familiarity with no‑code / AI automation platforms
  • Data literacy & visualization sense
  • Project management fundamentals

title: Senior Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant to the Co-Founders | CEO

FreeHealth.ai | AI Healthcare Companion & Digital Twin Platform


Role Summary

Served as a senior-level Executive Assistant working alongside the co-founders, acting as a strategic execution partner responsible for leadership accountability, project management, executive operations, and high-level outreach coordination across a fast-scaling AI healthcare platform.

Operated as a force multiplier for leadership, ensuring priorities were executed, commitments were tracked, and cross-functional initiatives moved forward with clarity and discipline.



Key Responsibilities


Leadership Accountability & Execution

  • Partnered directly with co-founders to track strategic priorities, decisions, and commitments
  • Maintained accountability across leadership and cross-functional teams
  • Proactively identified risks, blockers, and execution gaps
  • Ensured follow-through on all high-level initiatives


Project Management & Systems

  • Owned centralized project management across multiple initiatives and workstreams
  • Built and managed Monday.com at an advanced level , including dashboards, automations, dependencies, timelines, and executive reporting
  • Translated high-level strategy into actionable plans with clear owners and deadlines
  • Delivered concise executive updates and progress reports


Executive Operations

  • Managed complex calendars and priorities across multiple co-founders and time zones
  • Prepared leadership for meetings with briefs, agendas, and context
  • Captured action items and ensured post-meeting execution
  • Protected leadership time by filtering low-value meetings and distractions


Outreach & Relationship Management

  • Coordinated outreach to investors, partners, advisors, and senior stakeholders
  • Managed follow-ups, scheduling, and relationship tracking
  • Drafted professional communications on behalf of the co-founders
  • Ensured warm introductions and high-value opportunities were properly advanced


Process, Scale & Organizational Support

  • Helped design and refine operating rhythms, workflows, and SOPs
  • Supported hiring coordination and onboarding
  • Acted as connective tissue across teams, vendors, and leadership
  • Improved execution cadence and internal communication



Qualifications & Profile

  • Master’s degree or advanced graduate-level degree (MBA, MHA, MPH, MS, JD, or equivalent)
  • 7+ years supporting founders, C-suite executives, or leadership teams
  • Advanced, hands-on experience with Monday.com as an operating system
  • Strong project management and systems-thinking capabilities
  • Background in startups, healthcare, venture-backed companies, consulting, or high-growth environments
  • High emotional intelligence, discretion, and executive presence



Core Strengths

  • Leadership accountability
  • Executive operations
  • Advanced project management
  • Systems design and optimization
  • High-level communication
  • Strategic follow-through


To apply please visit and sign up for early access.

title: Remote SAT English Tutor - 50997
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

Day-to-day responsibilities:

As an SAT Tutor, you will work remotely with high school students preparing for U.S. college admissions. Your sessions will focus on strengthening reading, writing, and mathematical reasoning skills using official materials and proven strategies. You’ll conduct timed practice tests, review performance, and create personalized study plans to help students maximize their scores. Clear communication, consistent feedback, and student motivation will be essential to building confidence and exam readiness.


Requirements:

We’re seeking experienced tutors with a strong record of preparing students for the SAT. Candidates should understand the digital SAT format, be familiar with College Board materials, and have excellent academic English skills. High SAT scores or standardized test prep certifications are preferred. Strong teaching abilities, virtual instruction skills, and a results-driven approach are essential. Communication in English: Ability to clearly convey feedback, nuances, and progress updates to the team.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: Availability of up to 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 1 month
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los-Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will go through an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 51671


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: English Teacher
description:
Company Overview:


AM Consultoria de Inglês is dedicated to transforming our students' lives through exceptional English language services. We offer more than just English classes; our comprehensive approach includes personalised meetings and continuous follow-ups to ensure student success. Our team is innovative, passionate, and committed to overcoming obstacles for the sake of student development. If you are driven to make a significant impact on your students' lives, we invite you to join our dynamic team. However, if you are merely seeking a teaching position, AM Consultoria de Inglês may not be the right fit for you. We pride ourselves on honesty and transparency from the selection process through to our daily operations. Join us and achieve above-average results together!


Job Characteristics:

Position: ESL Teacher

Location: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Start Date: January 2026

Note: Candidates MUST be available to work Monday through Thursday, 7-9pm.


Responsibilities:

- Plan and deliver engaging, memorable classes.

- Respond to student inquiries via WhatsApp outside of class hours.

- Correct homework and activities on teaching platform.

- Periodically contact students to understand and meet their needs.

- Focus on student results beyond class hours.

- Offer comprehensive support to students in a compassionate manner.

- Pursue continuous professional development.

- Have good quality video and audio. 

- Have a high speed and reliable internet connection. 

- Participate in weekly team meetings (Monday’s at 10am, for 30 minutes)


Qualification:

CELTA, DELTA or TKT certification from Cambridge. 


What we are looking for:

- C2 English proficiency level

- Ability to teach using the communicative approach

- Teachers who bring positve energy to class 

- Strong ability to use online teaching platforms and digital tools effectively

- Ambition and a desire for growth, with the potential to become a leader.

- Humility and a willingness to learn and adapt.

- A positive attitude towards feedback, recognising its importance in improving client impact.

- Willingness to embrace responsibilities and challenges.

- Excellent communication skills to initiate and engage in conversations aimed at service improvement.

- Applicants with significant experience living, working, or studying in an English-speaking environment will be highly considered.


Why join us: 


- Join a growing company with great growth opportunities.

- Enjoy above-average remuneration compared to other ESL schools in Brazil.

- Work with motivated adult learners aiming for better job opportunities.

- Experience a unique teaching methodology distinct from market offerings.

- Contribute to and influence product development and improvements.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
What is our company?

Lead Generation Hub (LGH) connects top-tier talent with growing U.S. companies by helping them build a high-quality pipeline. Our clients come to us because they need consistent, qualified meetings, and they stay because our process is intelligent, results-driven, and without any BS. What sets LGH apart is our selective, performance-based network. Everyone who joins us is rigorously evaluated through interviews and practical tests that measure real outbound ability, not only theory and whatever is on your resume. We care about what you can actually do. If you don’t meet every requirement but truly believe you can perform at a high level, apply and reach out to us. We value grit, ownership, and confidence.



What will you be doing as a BDR at LGH?

You’ll work remotely as a full-time or part-time Business Development Representative for US companies. That means you won’t be prospecting for LGH itself, but for our clients. Your day-to-day will focus on identifying, prospecting, and engaging potential clients, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings with decision-makers, all through outbound outreach. Cold calling is at the heart of our methodology, supported by social and email outreach. You’ll also run weekly pipeline reviews with clients to ensure alignment and progress. All the tools, training, and methodology will be provided. At the same time, we encourage you to bring your own experience, tactics, and learned strategies to do your job and improve the process.


Qualifications

  • Advanced English. You’ll be cold-calling and selling in English every day.
  • You must have experience cold calling prospects outside of Brazil/LATAM, preferably to US companies.
  • Proficiency in B2B outbound lead generation techniques, with a results-oriented mindset.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, with good time management skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills for identifying and qualifying high-value leads.
  • Proficiency with CRM software and lead management tools.
  • Nice-to-have: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is advantageous.


Core Qualifications

  • Can you walk into a bar or social event and talk to anyone while enjoying it?
  • Can you handle rejection all day and still pick up the phone with energy on the next call?
  • Can you sit in front of your computer and make calls, one after another, for hours?


Interview Steps:

1) Interview with a recruiter at LGH

2) Panel interview with LGH leadership

3) Speak to a sales psychologist (if necessary)

4) Take a PAID practical assessment.


 – This isn’t a simulation. You’ll have a few hours to build a live pipeline for a real LGH client. The session is paid ($7.00 USD/hour), and for most candidates, it lasts around 2 hours.


5) Final Evaluation. Only candidates who pass every stage are invited into the LGH elite network. Once you’re in, we build your sales-focused resume and represent you to our U.S. clients to help ensure a consistent stream of work and income.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller
description:
Company Description

C17 Lab is a revenue engineering firm passionate about helping B2B companies overcome capacity and capability gaps in their go-to-market and revenue operations. By building data-driven outbound growth systems, we enable clients to achieve and exceed pipeline and revenue goals without increasing headcount. Our team provides hands-on support and strategic insights across the entire revenue cycle, from offer design and demand generation to CRM integration and reporting. We collaborate with organizations ranging from startups to enterprises, designing scalable and sustainable systems that drive measurable results.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Appointment Setter / Cold Caller. The individual in this role will be responsible for identifying potential leads, initiating outbound calls, engaging prospects, and scheduling appointments for the sales team. Additionally, the role involves managing schedules effectively, maintaining detailed records of interactions, and providing excellent customer service to establish trust and build strong client relationships.


The Role

We're looking for an Appointment Setter / Cold Caller to join our team and book qualified meetings for our clients. You'll be on the front lines of outbound, working high-volume calling campaigns across multiple industries. This isn't a role for someone who wants to coast—we run aggressive targets and expect consistent execution.


What You'll Do


Execute + outbound dials daily across client campaigns

Follow proven scripts while adapting to prospect responses in real-time

Book qualified appointments that meet strict ICP criteria

Manage Inbox communication

Collaborate with Campaign Managers and Strategists on targeting and messaging refinements

Hit weekly and monthly meeting quotas consistently



What We're Looking For


Minimum 1 year of cold calling or appointment setting experience in B2B

Proven track record of hitting quota—bring your numbers

Comfortable with rejection and high-volume activity

Clear, professional phone presence

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and professional setup

Coachable with a no-excuses attitude toward performance



Bonus Points


Experience in lead gen agencies or sales development roles

Familiarity with dialers, CRMs, and outbound tech stacks

Background calling into professional services, manufacturing, or mid-market B2B



Compensation

Base + performance bonuses tied to meetings booked. Top performers earn significantly more. Details discussed during interviews.


How to Apply

  • Follow our Linkedin Company Page and our Founder Enzo Carasso before applying so we can see that actually read the entire Job Description.
  • Once you've completed the above - send a connection request to Enzo Carasso with a short note on why you're a fit. Include your last 3 months of performance metrics if available-conversion rates, dials per day, meetings booked. No fluff, just results.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Lead Software Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer / Engineering Manager to lead and manage our growing tech team. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone with deep technical expertise and strong experience managing teams and delivering high-quality software.

You will be responsible for guiding architecture decisions, solving complex technical problems, and ensuring smooth execution across backend, frontend, and AI teams.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage a tech team of:
  • 2 Backend Engineers
  • 2 Frontend Engineers
  • 2 AI Engineers
  • Own the entire software development lifecycle from planning to deployment
  • Act as a hands-on technical leader (coding, code reviews, architecture decisions)
  • Solve complex technical challenges and unblock the team
  • Ensure tasks are delivered on time, with high quality and scalability
  • Improve engineering processes, standards, and best practices


Requirements:

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with Golang (Go) and Python (must-have )
  • Proven experience leading and managing engineering teams
  • Strong understanding of backend systems, APIs, and scalable architectures
  • Experience working with cloud platforms:
  • AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • DigitalOcean
  • Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills


Nice to have:

  • Experience working with AI/ML engineers and AI-powered systems
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Startup or fast-paced product development experience


What we offer:

  • Leadership role with high ownership and impact
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of the product
  • Competitive compensation (based on experience)
  • Flexible and collaborative work environment

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy scalable artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions. The role requires strong backend engineering skills with Go (Golang) and hands-on experience building production-grade AI systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain AI/ML solutions for business use cases
  • Build and maintain high-performance backend services using Go (Golang)
  • Deploy, integrate, and optimize machine learning models in production environments
  • Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to translate models into scalable services
  • Develop APIs and microservices for AI-powered applications
  • Monitor model performance and system reliability in production
  • Ensure code quality through testing, reviews, and documentation
  • Optimize system performance, scalability, and reliability

Mandatory Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with Go (Golang) – mandatory
  • Strong experience with Python – mandatory
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (such as AWS, GCP, or Azure and Digital Ocean)
  • Proven experience as an AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, or similar role
  • Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms and AI fundamentals
  • Experience working with Python-based ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn)
  • Experience deploying ML models to production systems
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with MLOps tools and workflows
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with NLP, Computer Vision, or Generative AI models
  • Knowledge of data engineering concepts and pipelines
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases


Required Skills

  • Go (Golang)
  • Paython
  • Machine Learning & AI
  • Python
  • API & Microservices Architecture
  • Cloud Computing
  • Problem Solving & Debugging

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

title: Business Development Partner
description:
About Darkex

Darkex aims to be leading cryptocurrency service platform headquartered in Dubai, with additional entities in Panama, Cayman, and Georgia. As a pioneer in the rapidly evolving digital asset industry, Darkex provides a comprehensive range of services including trading, asset management etc. to clients worldwide.


With a commitment to compliance, security, and innovation, Darkex is dedicated to providing reliable and transparent services that meet the needs of both individual and institutional investors in the digital economy.


Description:

Darkex is becoming one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges in Europe, serving a rapidly growing base of corporate customers. To support this growth, we are looking for long-term Business Development Partners who can help us expand our global reach through strong networks and local market access.



We are a good match if you:


  • Have an existing network in crypto, Web3, fintech, or trading
  • Can bring corporate clients, partners, communities, and KOL connections
  • Are strong at opening doors and closing partnerships
  • Understand local markets and how crypto users behave
  • Want to build a long-term partnership with an exchange, not a one-off deal


You should have:


  • Experience in business development, partnerships, or B2B sales (crypto or fintech)
  • A clear portfolio (partners, communities, institutions, or clients you work with)
  • Strong negotiation and communication skills
  • Basic knowledge of KYC / KYB and AML
  • Comfort in a client-facing role
  • Interest in crypto, trading, and blockchain


Your role:


  • Introduce and onboard new KOLs, business partners and corporate clients
  • Build and manage a qualified sales pipeline
  • Negotiate commercial terms
  • Work with internal teams on onboarding and growth
  • Support volume and revenue growth through partnerships
  • Report progress and achieve KPIs


What matters most:


  • Your network
  • Your portfolio
  • Your market access
  • Your interest in long-term collaboration

  • Experiência com PYTHON e outras linguagens;

title: DPM Analyst Intern (Full-Time | Remote - Brazil)
description:
DPM Analyst Intern (Full-Time | Remote - Brazil)


Elevate your career with a Google Premier Partner.


Smart Age Solutions is a leading New York-based Digital Marketing agency with a growing hub in Rio de Janeiro. As the only Google Premier Partner and META Preferred Partner in the luxury jewelry industry, we offer a world-class environment for aspiring digital marketers to learn from the best in the business.


We are looking for motivated talents in Brazil to join our team for a Full-Time unpaid Internship . This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the American market, master premium tools, and build a high-level career foundation in Paid Media.


What’s In It For You?

  • Expert Mentorship:  Work directly with industry experts in Google and Meta Ads.
  • Global Portfolio:  Gain experience managing campaigns for high-end US-based clients.
  • Career Path:  Opportunity for future paid roles based on performance and agency growth.
  • Language Development: Level up your english skills by practicing your speech and writing daily.
  • Remote Flexibility:  Work from anywhere in Brazil while collaborating with a New York team.


Role Overview:

As a DPM Analyst Intern, you will support the Paid Media team in the end-to-end lifecycle of digital campaigns. You will bridge the gap between data analysis and creative strategy, ensuring our clients stay ahead of the curve.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Campaign Support:  Assist in planning and launching ads across Google (Search, Display, PMax) and Meta (FB/IG).
  • Data Analysis:  Monitor performance metrics to identify trends and optimization opportunities.
  • Reporting:  Help create monthly performance reports and dashboards.
  • Technical Setup:  Learn to implement tracking and attribution via GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Collaboration:  Participate in strategic meetings with Account Managers to align campaigns with client goals.


Who We Are Looking For:

  • Language:  Advanced English  (written and spoken) is mandatory. The entire interview process and daily operations are in English.
  • Mindset:  Analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to learn in a fast-paced \"agency life\" environment.
  • Foundational Knowledge:  A basic understanding of how Google Ads and Meta Business Manager work. Bonus points if you have a few months to a year of experience working with paid media.
  • Tech Savvy:  Comfortable with Google Sheets/Excel and a natural interest in data-driven marketing.
  • Availability:  Based in Brazil and able to commit to a full-time schedule (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM BRT).


Tools You Will Master:

You will gain hands-on experience with the industry-standard \"Tech Stack\":

  • Advertising:  Google Ads & Facebook Business Manager.
  • Analytics:  Google Analytics 4 & Google Tag Manager.
  • Organization:  Google Workspace / Slack.


Position Details:

  • Type:  Full-Time Internship.
  • Compensation:  Unpaid.
  • Location:  100% Remote (Must be based in Brazil).
  • Application Requirement:  Resumes must be submitted in English .


Ready to shape the future of global digital innovation?  Apply now and start your journey into the luxury digital space with Smart Age Solutions!

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 51671


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: English Teacher
description:
Company Overview:


AM Consultoria de Inglês is dedicated to transforming our students' lives through exceptional English language services. We offer more than just English classes; our comprehensive approach includes personalised meetings and continuous follow-ups to ensure student success. Our team is innovative, passionate, and committed to overcoming obstacles for the sake of student development. If you are driven to make a significant impact on your students' lives, we invite you to join our dynamic team. However, if you are merely seeking a teaching position, AM Consultoria de Inglês may not be the right fit for you. We pride ourselves on honesty and transparency from the selection process through to our daily operations. Join us and achieve above-average results together!


Job Characteristics:

Position: ESL Teacher

Location: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Start Date: January 2026

Note: Candidates MUST be available to work Monday through Thursday, 7-9pm.


Responsibilities:

- Plan and deliver engaging, memorable classes.

- Respond to student inquiries via WhatsApp outside of class hours.

- Correct homework and activities on teaching platform.

- Periodically contact students to understand and meet their needs.

- Focus on student results beyond class hours.

- Offer comprehensive support to students in a compassionate manner.

- Pursue continuous professional development.

- Have good quality video and audio. 

- Have a high speed and reliable internet connection. 

- Participate in weekly team meetings (Monday’s at 10am, for 30 minutes)


Qualification:

CELTA, DELTA or TKT certification from Cambridge. 


What we are looking for:

- C2 English proficiency level

- Ability to teach using the communicative approach

- Teachers who bring positve energy to class 

- Strong ability to use online teaching platforms and digital tools effectively

- Ambition and a desire for growth, with the potential to become a leader.

- Humility and a willingness to learn and adapt.

- A positive attitude towards feedback, recognising its importance in improving client impact.

- Willingness to embrace responsibilities and challenges.

- Excellent communication skills to initiate and engage in conversations aimed at service improvement.

- Applicants with significant experience living, working, or studying in an English-speaking environment will be highly considered.


Why join us: 


- Join a growing company with great growth opportunities.

- Enjoy above-average remuneration compared to other ESL schools in Brazil.

- Work with motivated adult learners aiming for better job opportunities.

- Experience a unique teaching methodology distinct from market offerings.

- Contribute to and influence product development and improvements.

- Access professional development opportunities through the company.


We look forward to welcoming passionate and committed professionals to our team. Apply now and be part of a company that truly values and invests in both its students and its team.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. This role blends the expertise of building cutting-edge AI/ML models with the practical know-how of automation and agentic system integrations. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python , with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn , and Hugging Face Transformers .
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion .
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.
  • Proficiency in using REST APIs for tool and platform integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business problems into technical AI/automation solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks , voice automation, and prompt tuning systems.
  • Exposure to MLOps best practices , including model versioning, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning , GANs , or edge AI deployments .
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray .
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first .
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation across industries and verticals.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
What is our company?

Lead Generation Hub (LGH) connects top-tier talent with growing U.S. companies by helping them build a high-quality pipeline. Our clients come to us because they need consistent, qualified meetings, and they stay because our process is intelligent, results-driven, and without any BS. What sets LGH apart is our selective, performance-based network. Everyone who joins us is rigorously evaluated through interviews and practical tests that measure real outbound ability, not only theory and whatever is on your resume. We care about what you can actually do. If you don’t meet every requirement but truly believe you can perform at a high level, apply and reach out to us. We value grit, ownership, and confidence.



What will you be doing as a BDR at LGH?

You’ll work remotely as a full-time or part-time Business Development Representative for US companies. That means you won’t be prospecting for LGH itself, but for our clients. Your day-to-day will focus on identifying, prospecting, and engaging potential clients, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings with decision-makers, all through outbound outreach. Cold calling is at the heart of our methodology, supported by social and email outreach. You’ll also run weekly pipeline reviews with clients to ensure alignment and progress. All the tools, training, and methodology will be provided. At the same time, we encourage you to bring your own experience, tactics, and learned strategies to do your job and improve the process.


Qualifications

  • Advanced English. You’ll be cold-calling and selling in English every day.
  • You must have experience cold calling prospects outside of Brazil/LATAM, preferably to US companies.
  • Proficiency in B2B outbound lead generation techniques, with a results-oriented mindset.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, with good time management skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills for identifying and qualifying high-value leads.
  • Proficiency with CRM software and lead management tools.
  • Nice-to-have: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is advantageous.


Core Qualifications

  • Can you walk into a bar or social event and talk to anyone while enjoying it?
  • Can you handle rejection all day and still pick up the phone with energy on the next call?
  • Can you sit in front of your computer and make calls, one after another, for hours?


Interview Steps:

1) Interview with a recruiter at LGH

2) Panel interview with LGH leadership

3) Speak to a sales psychologist (if necessary)

4) Take a PAID practical assessment.


 – This isn’t a simulation. You’ll have a few hours to build a live pipeline for a real LGH client. The session is paid ($7.00 USD/hour), and for most candidates, it lasts around 2 hours.


5) Final Evaluation. Only candidates who pass every stage are invited into the LGH elite network. Once you’re in, we build your sales-focused resume and represent you to our U.S. clients to help ensure a consistent stream of work and income.

Elevate your career with a Google Premier Partner.


Smart Age Solutions is a leading New York-based Digital Marketing agency with a growing hub in Rio de Janeiro. As the only Google Premier Partner and META Preferred Partner in the luxury jewelry industry, we offer a world-class environment for aspiring digital marketers to learn from the best in the business.


We are looking for motivated talents in Brazil to join our team for a Full-Time unpaid Internship . This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the American market, master premium tools, and build a high-level career foundation in Paid Media.


What’s In It For You?

  • Expert Mentorship:  Work directly with industry experts in Google and Meta Ads.
  • Global Portfolio:  Gain experience managing campaigns for high-end US-based clients.
  • Career Path:  Opportunity for future paid roles based on performance and agency growth.
  • Language Development: Level up your english skills by practicing your speech and writing daily.
  • Remote Flexibility:  Work from anywhere in Brazil while collaborating with a New York team.


Role Overview:

As a DPM Analyst Intern, you will support the Paid Media team in the end-to-end lifecycle of digital campaigns. You will bridge the gap between data analysis and creative strategy, ensuring our clients stay ahead of the curve.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Campaign Support:  Assist in planning and launching ads across Google (Search, Display, PMax) and Meta (FB/IG).
  • Data Analysis:  Monitor performance metrics to identify trends and optimization opportunities.
  • Reporting:  Help create monthly performance reports and dashboards.
  • Technical Setup:  Learn to implement tracking and attribution via GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Collaboration:  Participate in strategic meetings with Account Managers to align campaigns with client goals.


Who We Are Looking For:

  • Language:  Advanced English  (written and spoken) is mandatory. The entire interview process and daily operations are in English.
  • Mindset:  Analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to learn in a fast-paced \"agency life\" environment.

description:

title: Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure
description:
Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure

Location: Remote; travel within-country

Sector: Modular Data Center Infrastructure (AI & HPC)

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer


About MatraVolt

MatraVolt is a deep-tech company building next-generation prefabricated infrastructure for the AI era. Our multi-module architecture enables high-density, liquid-cooled deployments with radically faster delivery, lower on-site risk, and superior total cost. The solution has been adopted by the one of the world’s largest AI data center project in the United States and we are now scaling across EU and Latin America with colocation providers, hyperscale developers, EPCs, and energy-conscious AI platforms.


Role Summary

We’re hiring a Country Head at MD level to drive MatraVolt’s go-to-market and commercial outcomes. You will build and convert a country-level pipeline with colocation operators, hyperscalers, developers/EPCs, and other players in the ecosystem, form strategic partnerships, and orchestrate complex, technical deals - positioning MatraVolt as the default choice for next-gen AI/HPC infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities
  • Market development: map priority accounts (colo, hyperscale, BTS developers, EPC/SIs, utilities/energy partners), create multi-threaded entry, and land flagship wins.
  • Enterprise sales: qualify, shape requirements, lead solutioning with engineering (high-density racks, liquid cooling, modular power/cooling blocks).
  • Partnerships & routes-to-market: establish and manage EPC / SI / channel alliances and project-specific consortiums.
  • Program leadership: drive country bids/RFPs; coordinate delivery timelines and site readiness with Operations.
  • Intelligence & feedback: provide structured market signals (customer pain, regulatory/power constraints, competitive moves) to sharpen product, pricing, and delivery playbooks.
  • Governance & risk: ensure compliance with customer, HSE, and site policies.


Ideal Profile
  • 5+ years in enterprise data center / critical infrastructure sales or BD.
  • Credible network among colocation buyers and AI/HPC stakeholders; comfortable at C-suite, engineering, and procurement levels.
  • Fluency in technical value: high-density GPU environments, liquid cooling, modular power & cooling blocks, prefabrication/off-site integration, and time-to-live economics.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on operator who can open doors, design the deal at startup pace.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese/Spanish and Fluent English


Contract Details
  • Type: Contractor / Independent Consultant
  • Compensation: Monthly travel allowance + uncapped, highly competitive success-based commission
  • Start: Immediate


Why Join MatraVolt
  • Scale a solution already validated by the largest AI data center deployment globally.
  • Work where deep-tech, energy, and AI compute converge—on real projects, fast.
  • High autonomy, tight engineering partnership, and a product that wins on speed and cost.
  • Shape the country playbook and help define how Latin America builds AI infrastructure.

As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure
description:
Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure

Location: Remote; travel within-country

Sector: Modular Data Center Infrastructure (AI & HPC)

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer


About MatraVolt

MatraVolt is a deep-tech company building next-generation prefabricated infrastructure for the AI era. Our multi-module architecture enables high-density, liquid-cooled deployments with radically faster delivery, lower on-site risk, and superior total cost. The solution has been adopted by the one of the world’s largest AI data center project in the United States and we are now scaling across EU and Latin America with colocation providers, hyperscale developers, EPCs, and energy-conscious AI platforms.


Role Summary

We’re hiring a Country Head at MD level to drive MatraVolt’s go-to-market and commercial outcomes. You will build and convert a country-level pipeline with colocation operators, hyperscalers, developers/EPCs, and other players in the ecosystem, form strategic partnerships, and orchestrate complex, technical deals - positioning MatraVolt as the default choice for next-gen AI/HPC infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities
  • Market development: map priority accounts (colo, hyperscale, BTS developers, EPC/SIs, utilities/energy partners), create multi-threaded entry, and land flagship wins.
  • Enterprise sales: qualify, shape requirements, lead solutioning with engineering (high-density racks, liquid cooling, modular power/cooling blocks).
  • Partnerships & routes-to-market: establish and manage EPC / SI / channel alliances and project-specific consortiums.
  • Program leadership: drive country bids/RFPs; coordinate delivery timelines and site readiness with Operations.
  • Intelligence & feedback: provide structured market signals (customer pain, regulatory/power constraints, competitive moves) to sharpen product, pricing, and delivery playbooks.
  • Governance & risk: ensure compliance with customer, HSE, and site policies.


Ideal Profile
  • 5+ years in enterprise data center / critical infrastructure sales or BD.
  • Credible network among colocation buyers and AI/HPC stakeholders; comfortable at C-suite, engineering, and procurement levels.
  • Fluency in technical value: high-density GPU environments, liquid cooling, modular power & cooling blocks, prefabrication/off-site integration, and time-to-live economics.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on operator who can open doors, design the deal at startup pace.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese/Spanish and Fluent English


Contract Details
  • Type: Contractor / Independent Consultant
  • Compensation: Monthly travel allowance + uncapped, highly competitive success-based commission
  • Start: Immediate


Why Join MatraVolt
  • Scale a solution already validated by the largest AI data center deployment globally.
  • Work where deep-tech, energy, and AI compute converge—on real projects, fast.
  • High autonomy, tight engineering partnership, and a product that wins on speed and cost.
  • Shape the country playbook and help define how Latin America builds AI infrastructure.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. This role blends the expertise of building cutting-edge AI/ML models with the practical know-how of automation and agentic system integrations. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python , with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn , and Hugging Face Transformers .
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion .
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.
  • Proficiency in using REST APIs for tool and platform integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business problems into technical AI/automation solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks , voice automation, and prompt tuning systems.
  • Exposure to MLOps best practices , including model versioning, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning , GANs , or edge AI deployments .
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray .
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first .
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation across industries and verticals.

title: DPM Analyst Intern (Full-Time | Remote - Brazil)
description:
DPM Analyst Intern (Full-Time | Remote - Brazil)


Elevate your career with a Google Premier Partner.


Smart Age Solutions is a leading New York-based Digital Marketing agency with a growing hub in Rio de Janeiro. As the only Google Premier Partner and META Preferred Partner in the luxury jewelry industry, we offer a world-class environment for aspiring digital marketers to learn from the best in the business.


We are looking for motivated talents in Brazil to join our team for a Full-Time unpaid Internship . This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the American market, master premium tools, and build a high-level career foundation in Paid Media.


What’s In It For You?

  • Expert Mentorship:  Work directly with industry experts in Google and Meta Ads.
  • Global Portfolio:  Gain experience managing campaigns for high-end US-based clients.
  • Career Path:  Opportunity for future paid roles based on performance and agency growth.
  • Language Development: Level up your english skills by practicing your speech and writing daily.
  • Remote Flexibility:  Work from anywhere in Brazil while collaborating with a New York team.


Role Overview:

As a DPM Analyst Intern, you will support the Paid Media team in the end-to-end lifecycle of digital campaigns. You will bridge the gap between data analysis and creative strategy, ensuring our clients stay ahead of the curve.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Campaign Support:  Assist in planning and launching ads across Google (Search, Display, PMax) and Meta (FB/IG).
  • Data Analysis:  Monitor performance metrics to identify trends and optimization opportunities.
  • Reporting:  Help create monthly performance reports and dashboards.
  • Technical Setup:  Learn to implement tracking and attribution via GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Collaboration:  Participate in strategic meetings with Account Managers to align campaigns with client goals.


Who We Are Looking For:

  • Language:  Advanced English  (written and spoken) is mandatory. The entire interview process and daily operations are in English.
  • Mindset:  Analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to learn in a fast-paced \"agency life\" environment.
  • Foundational Knowledge:  A basic understanding of how Google Ads and Meta Business Manager work. Bonus points if you have a few months to a year of experience working with paid media.
  • Tech Savvy:  Comfortable with Google Sheets/Excel and a natural interest in data-driven marketing.
  • Availability:  Based in Brazil and able to commit to a full-time schedule (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM BRT).


Tools You Will Master:

You will gain hands-on experience with the industry-standard \"Tech Stack\":

  • Advertising:  Google Ads & Facebook Business Manager.
  • Analytics:  Google Analytics 4 & Google Tag Manager.
  • Organization:  Google Workspace / Slack.


Position Details:

  • Type:  Full-Time Internship.
  • Compensation:  Unpaid.
  • Location:  100% Remote (Must be based in Brazil).
  • Application Requirement:  Resumes must be submitted in English .


Ready to shape the future of global digital innovation?  Apply now and start your journey into the luxury digital space with Smart Age Solutions!

title: Business Development Partner
description:
About Darkex

Darkex aims to be leading cryptocurrency service platform headquartered in Dubai, with additional entities in Panama, Cayman, and Georgia. As a pioneer in the rapidly evolving digital asset industry, Darkex provides a comprehensive range of services including trading, asset management etc. to clients worldwide.


With a commitment to compliance, security, and innovation, Darkex is dedicated to providing reliable and transparent services that meet the needs of both individual and institutional investors in the digital economy.


Description:

Darkex is becoming one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges in Europe, serving a rapidly growing base of corporate customers. To support this growth, we are looking for long-term Business Development Partners who can help us expand our global reach through strong networks and local market access.



We are a good match if you:


  • Have an existing network in crypto, Web3, fintech, or trading
  • Can bring corporate clients, partners, communities, and KOL connections
  • Are strong at opening doors and closing partnerships
  • Understand local markets and how crypto users behave
  • Want to build a long-term partnership with an exchange, not a one-off deal


You should have:


  • Experience in business development, partnerships, or B2B sales (crypto or fintech)
  • A clear portfolio (partners, communities, institutions, or clients you work with)
  • Strong negotiation and communication skills
  • Basic knowledge of KYC / KYB and AML
  • Comfort in a client-facing role
  • Interest in crypto, trading, and blockchain


Your role:


  • Introduce and onboard new KOLs, business partners and corporate clients
  • Build and manage a qualified sales pipeline
  • Negotiate commercial terms
  • Work with internal teams on onboarding and growth
  • Support volume and revenue growth through partnerships
  • Report progress and achieve KPIs


What matters most:


  • Your network
  • Your portfolio
  • Your market access
  • Your interest in long-term collaboration

title: Business Development Representative
description:
What is our company?

Lead Generation Hub (LGH) connects top-tier talent with growing U.S. companies by helping them build a high-quality pipeline. Our clients come to us because they need consistent, qualified meetings, and they stay because our process is intelligent, results-driven, and without any BS. What sets LGH apart is our selective, performance-based network. Everyone who joins us is rigorously evaluated through interviews and practical tests that measure real outbound ability, not only theory and whatever is on your resume. We care about what you can actually do. If you don’t meet every requirement but truly believe you can perform at a high level, apply and reach out to us. We value grit, ownership, and confidence.



What will you be doing as a BDR at LGH?

You’ll work remotely as a full-time or part-time Business Development Representative for US companies. That means you won’t be prospecting for LGH itself, but for our clients. Your day-to-day will focus on identifying, prospecting, and engaging potential clients, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings with decision-makers, all through outbound outreach. Cold calling is at the heart of our methodology, supported by social and email outreach. You’ll also run weekly pipeline reviews with clients to ensure alignment and progress. All the tools, training, and methodology will be provided. At the same time, we encourage you to bring your own experience, tactics, and learned strategies to do your job and improve the process.


Qualifications

  • Advanced English. You’ll be cold-calling and selling in English every day.
  • You must have experience cold calling prospects outside of Brazil/LATAM, preferably to US companies.
  • Proficiency in B2B outbound lead generation techniques, with a results-oriented mindset.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, with good time management skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills for identifying and qualifying high-value leads.
  • Proficiency with CRM software and lead management tools.
  • Nice-to-have: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is advantageous.


Core Qualifications

  • Can you walk into a bar or social event and talk to anyone while enjoying it?
  • Can you handle rejection all day and still pick up the phone with energy on the next call?
  • Can you sit in front of your computer and make calls, one after another, for hours?


Interview Steps:

1) Interview with a recruiter at LGH

2) Panel interview with LGH leadership

3) Speak to a sales psychologist (if necessary)

4) Take a PAID practical assessment.


 – This isn’t a simulation. You’ll have a few hours to build a live pipeline for a real LGH client. The session is paid ($7.00 USD/hour), and for most candidates, it lasts around 2 hours.


5) Final Evaluation. Only candidates who pass every stage are invited into the LGH elite network. Once you’re in, we build your sales-focused resume and represent you to our U.S. clients to help ensure a consistent stream of work and income.
